baseline: Short the probes, then check known V022-V016 once to establish actual pad-contact resistance. Prior shorted tips were about 0.5 ohm; use today's reading.
method: Battery and programmer disconnected; use resistance mode.
A stable reading close to the known connected-pair baseline supports a DC connection. Recheck near-zero hits with probes reversed; do not rely on a beep alone.
Record actual ohms, kohms, OL, or a changing reading. Tens/hundreds of ohms, one-way conduction or a changing reading are not direct-copper confirmation.
A very low-resistance path can include a zero-ohm link or an inductor; continuity maps electrical connectivity, not exact buried-layer track geometry.

power_path_update.user_report: Battery plus goes to Q1; Q1.L reaches H-bridge pin4 VDD. VBAT is not directly connected to VDD.
power_path_update.interpretation: Separate copper nets across a semiconductor; not a claim of complete electrical isolation or a diode-mode result.

candidate_q1.status: R1A marking matches Formosa FMOS3401A datasheet p5; SOT-23 PMOS with G=1 (photo R), S=2 (photo L), D=3 (photo single S). Candidate identification, not manufacturer proof. Drain at battery+ and source at load support reverse-polarity protection; gate-control behavior not verified. Earlier MMBT3904 NPN hypothesis withdrawn.

retained_hypotheses: TP14 battery-side copper is photo-supported; latest user report explicitly probes the battery/Q1/output path.
Other inferred gate-control and sensing branches are not certified by this correction.
additional_user_reports: V035 is connected to VREF TP
V042 is connected to VDD TP
User authorizes naming the unlabelled Q1-output rail VSYS.
L1/L2 are connected to the same VSYS.
power_path_update.confirmed_existing_net: V042-PIC20 VDD-C32.1 is confirmed to TP103 VDD; no new net merge.
power_path_update.naming_policy: User requested the printed labels BATTERY (+/-), VDD, VREF and GND, then explicitly authorized naming the unlabelled post-Q1 supply. VSYS is that new name: Q1.L/native2, MX512H pin4, L1 and L2 supply sides. Battery (-) is on GND.
power_path_update.l1_l2_confirmation: v0.9.9: User confirms L1 and L2 connect to the same VSYS after Q1. Existing supply-side pad1 selections retained from photos/model; opposite terminals are separate across each component. The report does not identify inductance/ferrite type or measured values.

staged_followups.action: The 11.2 kohm result matches R18+R19 nominal resistance. With V075 at VDD and IMG_2434, this supports R19 as a base-emitter pull-up and R18 as a series base-drive resistor. The native v0.9.8 reconstruction uses this qualified topology; in-circuit resistance alone does not uniquely prove it.

User confirms RC2/V049 to TP3, RB0/V026 to TP16/Q2 (corrected v0.9.16), and V071/R21.2 to VREF. RC1/PIC12 now reaches R18 via V053-V070; old V053-VREF link rejected. No PIC pads remain open in the model. Other inferred branches and remote roles still need review.

The first sweep tested V090 against four nodes; the second tested whether the other four shared a separate node. Seven OL results weaken that repeated-cell common-node hypothesis. No more broad pairwise tests are queued. V100-V103, V100-V107 and V103-V107 remain untested; no mutual isolation is assumed. Any next capacitor check must follow a visible trace or a specific antenna/component endpoint.

Q1.L/V011-V014 now confirmed to motor VDD/U5 pin4; no further rail-disambiguation test requested. Q1 is an R1A/FMOS3401A-class PMOS candidate. Raw battery BATTERY+ is distinct from post-Q1 VSYS; TP14 is on the raw side by photo. V015/R43.2 now reaches TP14; V017/R42.1/R44.1 reaches TP4/PIC25. V082 reaches TP103/logic VDD and measured D3.R; only that D3 terminal moved from the hypothetical receiver rail. D3.L is GND and D3.S-to-R42 reads 1.2 ohm. V075 has a confirmed rail and photo/resistance-supported Q7/R19 terminal assignments; Q7 identity, orientation and function remain qualified. V011-V015 is explicitly excluded.
V067 now connects J3.1/PIR supply to the earlier U6A pad association. U6A remains DNP; this does not identify an IC. Do not repeat established grounds, motor pairs, Q1 duplicate vias or V079/V080.
